chunks: He was born in the month of Ramadan in the year 385 [AH].

key_terms.سَنَةَ: year — here referring to the Hijri (Islamic lunar) calendar
key_terms.شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: the month of Ramadan — the ninth month of the Islamic lunar calendar, held sacred as the month of the Quran's revelation

ai.seo_question: When was Shaykh al-Tusi (Shaykh al-Ta'ifa), compiler of Tahdhib al-Ahkam, born?
ai.summary: This terse biographical entry records the birth of Shaykh al-Tusi (Shaykh al-Ta'ifa Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Tusi), compiler of Tahdhib al-Ahkam, in the blessed month of Ramadan, 385 AH (c. 995 CE). The notation of Ramadan as his birth month carries special resonance in Islamic tradition, as it is the month in which the Quran was revealed (Quran 2:185).
